correctness.rationale: The minimal nonfaces are precisely the original triangles and the private triangles {u,v,w_uv}; a private vertex has only its two endpoints as neighbors. In the triangle-free case the private circuits have unique markers, and no isolated vertices ensures they cover all n+m vertices, so Ehrenborg–Hetyei Proposition 4.3 gives simple-homotopy type S^(n−1). For a base triangle abc, neither endpoint of the contraction edge {w_ab,w_ac} shares a minimal nonface with the other. This is the cited link condition; explicitly a face disjoint from the pair can be extended by both whenever it can be extended by each separately. After contraction, a face could fail to extend to the new vertex only if it contained both {a,b} and {a,c}, which is impossible since it would contain the original forbidden triangle. The quotient is a cone and collapses, proving the claimed simple-homotopy equivalence, not a collapse-only statement for the original complex. For m≥2 the Alexander dual cover by complements of the private circuits has nerve the boundary simplex on E, naturally under automorphisms; an omitted private edge leaves its private vertex in the intersection, whereas all circuits cover the ground set. The complementary-face chain pairing has the ambient determinant twist, so the edge sign cancels and the original vertex sign remains. An independent trace argument verifies the sign: each g-invariant face contributes minus (−1) to the power of its number of g-cycles, including the empty face. Fix its original-vertex subset U. All private vertices with edges not contained in U are independently available in the triangle-free case, and choosing whether to include each available g-orbit cancels the sum unless no such orbit exists. The only uncancelled term is U=V by the no-isolated-vertices hypothesis; the reduced Lefschetz number is (−1)^(1+#vertex cycles). Since only degree n−1 survives and its group is infinite cyclic, the integral action is exactly the sign of g on V. For m=1 the class is the triangular boundary for K_2 and its orientation check is direct. I inspected verify.py and VERIFY_OUTPUT.txt without executing the script; the ten mod-two Betti checks and fourteen integral signed traces are finite checks, not evidence of all-graph homology or simple-homotopy type on their own.

value.rationale: The result gives a uniform detection rule relating triangles of the original graph to the simple-homotopy type after augmentation. More distinctly, it tells which automorphisms preserve orientation integrally, a datum invisible to the earlier nonequivariant sphere theorem and ordinary Betti numbers. This is useful for comparing graph symmetries and their induced actions without enumerating faces or generators.
